title: IPMAT Entrance Preparation
tagline: Focused preparation for the Integrated Programme in Management aptitude tests used by the IIMs.
overview: IPMAT is the entrance examination for the five-year Integrated Programme in Management offered by IIM Indore and IIM Rohtak, which combines an undergraduate degree with an MBA. Preparation covers quantitative ability in both multiple-choice and short-answer formats, verbal ability and logical reasoning, followed by the written ability and personal interview rounds. Coaching runs alongside the intermediate programme.
highlights: Quantitative ability, both MCQ and short answer
Written ability test and interview practice
